// diagnostic

E0375

`#Default` on a field is retired.

What

`#Default` on a field is retired.

Why

Field absence and construction defaults ride the field's type as `field: T{{expr}}` (D-DEFAULT-SHAPE1=B).

Fix

Write `field: T{{expr}}` instead of `#Default(expr)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0375: tests/ui/field_default_marker_retired.stderr.

Error [E0375]: `#Default` on a field is retired.

 Why: field absence and construction defaults ride the field's type as `field: T{expr}` (D-DEFAULT-SHAPE1=B).
 Fix: write `field: T{expr}` instead of `#Default(expr)`.
